description: React component for a sidebar navigation menu in a dashboard frontend application. It displays navigational buttons corresponding to different sections such as Dashboard, Folders, Tagging, KPIs, Templates, Export, and Scheduling, and manages active state via props.

methods.name: Sidebar({ active, setActive })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a sidebar with navigation buttons. Accepts props 'active' (currently active menu key) and 'setActive' (function to update active menu).
